title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Ten no-purchase activities for current FSU students, plus a public art museum open to everyone, verified through current official university pages.

cards.entity_name: Florida State University Museum of Fine Arts
cards.title: Browse the MoFA Galleries
cards.subtitle: A free public art outing on West Call Street
cards.notes: Meet inside the Fine Arts Building and browse the current exhibitions; check the museum page before visiting for closure updates.
cards.short_summary: An admission-free gallery meetup with changing historical and contemporary art exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum states that MoFA is always free and open to the public and publishes its current visiting hours.
cards.source_title: Visitor Information - Museum of Fine Arts
cards.access_notes: Open to the public without admission; visit during posted museum hours, which are subject to university and holiday closures.

cards.title: Paddle Lake Bradford by Kayak
cards.subtitle: A free one-hour paddle for current FSU students
cards.notes: Bring your FSUCard, check in at the Rental Office, and choose a single or tandem kayak for an hour on the connected lakes.
cards.short_summary: A student-only free kayak rental turns a Lakefront Park meetup into a paddle outing.
cards.evidence_claim: FSU says single and tandem kayak rentals are free for current students and Campus Recreation members with a valid FSUCard.
cards.access_notes: Free for current FSU students with a valid FSUCard during open park hours; follow Rental Office and water-safety requirements.

cards.entity_name: Stand-Up Paddleboarding at FSU Lakefront Park
cards.title: Try a Stand-Up Paddleboard
cards.subtitle: No-cost board time on Lake Bradford for current students
cards.notes: Check the facility status, bring your FSUCard, and ask the Rental Office for a paddleboard before heading onto Lake Bradford.
cards.short_summary: A free student paddleboard checkout offers a social balance challenge on the lake.
cards.evidence_claim: The official activities-and-fees page lists stand-up paddleboards among watercraft rentals that are free for FSU students and Campus Recreation members with valid ID.
cards.access_notes: Free for current FSU students with a valid FSUCard while the park and watercraft operation are open; weather may affect availability.

cards.title: Swim in the Lakefront Beach Area
cards.subtitle: Guarded lake swimming included with free student entry
cards.notes: Check the live facility status, enter with your FSUCard, and stay within the guarded designated swimming area at Lake Bradford.
cards.short_summary: A free student beach hang centered on the park’s designated lake swimming area.
cards.evidence_claim: FSU identifies swimming as a Lakefront Park activity and states that gate entry is free for FSU students and Campus Recreation members with a valid FSUCard.
cards.access_notes: Free with valid FSUCard during open park hours; swim only when the designated guarded area is operating and observe posted safety rules.

cards.entity_name: Sand Volleyball at FSU Lakefront Park
cards.title: Start a Sand Volleyball Game
cards.subtitle: Two lakefront courts with no added student charge
cards.notes: Gather a group, enter with your FSUCard, and use one of the two courts; ask the Rental Office about equipment checkout.
cards.short_summary: A casual team hang on the park’s two sand volleyball courts beside Lake Bradford.
cards.evidence_claim: FSU says Lakefront Park has two sand volleyball courts, calls the listed games free with park admission, and grants free gate entry to current FSU students with valid ID.
cards.source_title: FSU Lakefront Park – FSU Campus Recreation
cards.access_notes: Current FSU students enter free with a valid FSUCard during normal lakefront hours; courts are shared and subject to availability.

cards.entity_name: Disc Golf at FSU Lakefront Park
cards.title: Play the Nine-Hole Disc Golf Course
cards.subtitle: A free round winding through the Lakefront property
cards.notes: Bring friends and your FSUCard, then follow the nine-hole route through the property; equipment is available at the Rental Office.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission student round across the Lakefront Park’s nine-hole disc golf layout.
cards.evidence_claim: FSU documents a nine-hole disc golf course, says the listed games are free with park admission, and provides free park entry to current students with valid FSUCard.
cards.source_title: FSU Lakefront Park – FSU Campus Recreation
cards.access_notes: Free for current FSU students with valid FSUCard during open park hours; ask staff about course conditions and equipment availability.

cards.entity_name: Climbing Wall at FSU Lakefront Park
cards.title: Scale the 40-Foot Climbing Wall
cards.subtitle: A seasonal free climb for current FSU students
cards.notes: Wear closed-toe shoes, bring your FSUCard, and visit during posted weekend sessions in fall or spring; the wall closes for summer.
cards.short_summary: A staffed seasonal climbing session on the Lakefront Park’s 40-foot wall.
cards.evidence_claim: FSU states that the climbing wall and high course are free for FSU students with valid ID and posts their fall and spring operating window.
cards.access_notes: Free for current FSU students with valid FSUCard; closed during summer and normally offered on posted fall and spring weekend sessions. Closed-toe shoes required.

cards.entity_name: Indoor Track at Bobby E. Leach Student Recreation Center
cards.title: Walk or Run the Leach Indoor Track
cards.subtitle: A weatherproof campus loop free to current students
cards.notes: Bring your FSUCard and set an easy group pace on the indoor track; confirm the Leach Center’s operational hours before meeting.
cards.short_summary: A rain-or-shine social walk or run inside FSU’s central recreation facility.
cards.evidence_claim: FSU lists the Leach Center indoor track among fitness-facility options that are free for current students.
cards.access_notes: Free to current FSU students; a current valid FSUCard is required for facility entry, and access follows posted Leach Center hours.

cards.entity_name: Pick-Up Basketball at Bobby E. Leach Student Recreation Center
cards.title: Join a Pick-Up Basketball Game
cards.subtitle: Open play on Leach Center Courts 1 and 2
cards.notes: Bring your FSUCard and meet on Courts 1 or 2, which FSU designates for pick-up basketball; check facility hours first.
cards.short_summary: An informal, no-cost student game on regulation-size indoor courts at Leach.
cards.evidence_claim: FSU identifies Leach Courts 1 and 2 for pick-up basketball and states that its fitness facilities are free for current students.
cards.source_title: Leach Center & FMC – FSU Campus Recreation
cards.access_notes: Free to current FSU students with a current valid FSUCard; court access depends on operating hours and scheduled facility use.

cards.title: Take a Group Fitness Class
cards.subtitle: Dozens of free class formats for current FSU students
cards.notes: Choose a class from the current schedule and register when required; booking opens 25 hours before the session in FSU’s rec tools.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled workout hang spanning formats such as yoga, cycling, barre, and cardio.
cards.evidence_claim: FSU says its weekly group-fitness classes are free for current students and Campus Recreation members, with advance registration required for select sessions.
cards.access_notes: Free for current FSU students; consult the live schedule and register for select classes beginning 25 hours before the session.
